subject: 🎯 Stock Finder: Sun Sep 6 shortlist | thin, large-cap-only week — VLO best setup
html_body:
🎯 Stock Finder — Momentum Discovery

Sunday, September 6, 2026 — Kuwait time

4 candidates cleared the gates

All 4 are large-cap. Small/mid-cap lane came up empty after screening 11 names — see cut list.

~20 raw tickers pulled across 25 web searches + IBKR topic/theme lookups. 4 survived all 4 pre-screen gates; 15 were cut — one for the exact defense-contract trap this scan is built to catch (GSIT / Army SBIR).

⚠️ Read before placing anything

3 of these 4 names (PFE, JNJ, SOLV) are healthcare/pharma. Don't take all three plus your existing GOOG/SPXC without checking total sector weighting — this run is healthcare-concentrated, not by design, just by what actually cleared the gates.

Account Context

Per portfolio.json (last verified 2026-08-25): net liq ~$535.68, cash available $330.60. Sizing below uses $535 as the 15% base (~$80/position).
Holding 2 positions today: GOOG (0.3 sh) and SPXC (0.5 sh — flagged for exit on the defense-rule violation, Kranze Technology Solutions segment). That leaves room for 1-3 new names before the 5-7 concurrent-position ceiling.

Momentum Shortlist

Run analyze [TICKER] for the full deep dive before entering any of these.
#1 — VLO Valero Energy Corp ⭐⭐⭐⭐ 4/5
Energy · Oil Refining · LARGE CAP

Signal: Steady staircase higher for 5 straight sessions ($358.92→$361.99→$366.09→$370.69→$370.72, Aug31–Sep4). Sep 4 dipped intraday to $360.31 and was bought straight back to close near the day's high — a defended dip, not a breakdown. Fired within the last 1-2 trading days.

Price: $370.60 (IBKR live)  |  Avg daily $ vol: ~$1.05B (IBKR)  |  RS vs SPY: refining sub-industry +104% YTD vs S&P ~+12% YTD

Why it's interesting: WTI 3-2-1 crack spreads near $59/bbl, nearly triple where they started the year — this is a real margin story, not sentiment. VLO's grind-higher-with-a-bought-dip is the cleanest chart of anything in this scan.

Realistic near-term target: +2-5% over 3-7 trading days — next resistance $378, extension to $390.

Entry read: BUY AT MARKET — this is a bought pullback, not a chase.

Order plan (GTC): BUY limit $370.60 · stop-limit trigger $362.00 / limit $360.50 (just below the Sep3/Sep4 defended low) · TP1 sell limit $378.00 · TP2 $390.00 · size ~0.22 sh ≈ $81.55 (~15.2% of $535) · R:R ~1.9:1 blended

Event window: Catalyst (margin cycle, not a single date) already behind it ✅. Soft context: refiners as a group are up 80-100%+ YTD, and every prior similarly steep run over the last several years was followed by an average ~10% pullback over the next 6 months — a medium-term risk, not a same-week one, but a reason to take profit fast rather than press it.

Halal: ✅ Verified — oil refining/marketing, no interest/gambling/alcohol issue.   Defense/military: ✅ Clear.

Sizing note: Requires fractional shares (0.22) — confirm enabled first. ~$2 round-trip commission on an ~$82 position is ~2.4% drag — TP1 alone barely clears it, lean toward holding for TP2 if the move confirms.

Next step: analyze VLO
#2 — PFE Pfizer Inc ⭐⭐⭐⭐ 4/5
Healthcare · Pharma · LARGE CAP

Signal: Broke to a fresh 52-week high of $29.21 on Sep 3 (Q2 beat-and-raise: EPS $0.77 vs $0.68 est., revenue $15.03B vs $14.42B est., FY revenue guidance raised), then gave back ~2.6% over two sessions to $28.44 — a controlled pullback into the prior breakout shelf. Fired 2 trading days ago.

Price: $28.44 (IBKR live)  |  Avg daily $ vol: ~$1.2B (IBKR)  |  RS vs SPY: +20% YTD, clearly outperforming a flat tape this week

Why it's interesting: The cleanest post-earnings-drift setup in the scan — the binary event is fully behind it, guidance was raised not cut, and price sits in the exact pullback zone you'd want to buy rather than chase the Sep 3 spike.

Realistic near-term target: +2-5% over 3-5 trading days — retest of $29.21, extension to $30.00.

Entry read: BUY AT MARKET — bought the pullback, not the spike.

Order plan (GTC): BUY limit $28.45 · stop-limit trigger $28.05 / limit $27.85 (below the Aug28-31 consolidation shelf) · TP1 sell limit $29.20 · TP2 $30.00 · size 3 sh ≈ $85.35 (~16.0% of $535) · R:R ~1.9:1 blended

Event window: Catalyst (Q2 earnings) already behind it ✅. No dated event inside the holding window.

Halal: ✅ Verified — pharmaceuticals, core business permissible.   Defense/military: ✅ Clear.

Sizing note: Whole shares — no fractional needed.

Next step: analyze PFE
#3 — JNJ Johnson & Johnson ⭐⭐⭐⭐ 4/5
Healthcare · Pharma/Medtech · LARGE CAP

Signal: Fresh 52-week high of $281.07 on Sep 2 — the largest name on a Trefis list of 18 S&P 500 names at new highs that day (9 healthcare, 6 energy). Pulled back to $275-278 over two sessions but held a rising sequence of lows (Sep3 low $273.15 → Sep4 low $274.75). Fired 2 trading days ago.

Price: $276.53 (IBKR live)  |  Avg daily $ vol: ~$2.1B (IBKR)  |  RS vs SPY: ~+7.8% over the past month while the broad tape chopped sideways

Why it's interesting: This is sector-rotation money (9 healthcare names at highs the same day), not a single-stock story — that tends to have more follow-through than an isolated pop.

Realistic near-term target: +2-3% over 3-5 trading days — retest of $281, extension to $284.

Entry read: BUY AT MARKET — orderly pullback with rising lows.

Order plan (GTC): BUY limit $276.53 · stop-limit trigger $272.80 / limit $272.00 (below the Sep3 swing low) · TP1 sell limit $281.00 · TP2 $284.00 · size ~0.3 sh ≈ $82.96 (~15.5% of $535) · R:R ~1.6:1 blended

Event window: Catalyst (sector rotation, not a dated event) already behind it ✅.

Halal: ✅ Verified — pharma/medtech, core business permissible.   Defense/military: ✅ Clear.

Sizing note: Requires fractional shares (0.3) — confirm enabled. Same ~2.4% commission-drag note as VLO.

Next step: analyze JNJ
#4 — SOLV Solventum Corp ⭐⭐⭐ 3/5
Healthcare · Medtech · LARGE-MID CAP

Signal: Testing the $93-94 zone repeatedly over 4 sessions — Sep1 spiked intraday to $94.16 then reversed hard to close $90.95; Sep3 pushed back to $94.12 before fading to $92.44; now $91.69. Three touches of resistance, no clean breakout yet. Backed by Q2 organic sales growth of 9.5% and an EPS raise to $7.10-7.20, with the 3M spin-off separation nearing completion. Fired within the last 3-5 trading days, still intact.

Price: $91.69 (IBKR live)  |  Avg daily $ vol: ~$112M (IBKR)  |  RS vs SPY: +26.8% over the past year

Why it's interesting: A real breakout above $94 would be clean and earnings-backed — but unlike VLO/PFE/JNJ, this one hasn't confirmed yet. Weakest-conviction name on the list; treat as a watch-for-breakout, not a sure thing.

Realistic near-term target: +2-6% over 4-7 trading days if $94 breaks — extension to $97.

Entry read: BUY AT MARKET, sized modestly — resistance hasn't broken yet.

Order plan (GTC): BUY limit $91.69 · stop-limit trigger $90.60 / limit $90.30 (below the Sep1 swing low) · TP1 sell limit $94.00 · TP2 $97.00 · size 1 sh ≈ $91.69 (~17.1% of $535) · R:R ~1.7:1 blended

Event window: Catalyst (Q2 earnings) already behind it ✅.

Halal: ✅ Verified — medical devices/wound care/filtration (3M healthcare spin-off), core business permissible.   Defense/military: ✅ Clear.

Sizing note: Whole share — no fractional needed.

Next step: analyze SOLV

🏆 Today's Best Setup

VLO — the cleanest chart of the four: a 5-day staircase higher into record refining margins (crack spreads near $59/bbl, ~3x January levels), with a defended dip to $360 on Sep 4 that closed back near the day's high instead of breaking down. Real fundamental driver, not just a chart pattern.
Invalidation: A close below $360.50 — that would mean the Sep4 dip-buy failed and the staircase pattern is broken. That's the stop reference, not a percentage guess.

Cut This Run (15 names)

GSIT — DEFENSE-CONTRACT catalyst: its 39%+ rally is tied in part to a U.S. Army SBIR contract win; excluded under the no-defense-contract rule even though GSI isn't a defense prime.
MPC — extension risk: real refining-margin story (same theme as VLO), but Sep3 spiked to a fresh 52-week high of $398.53 and reversed the same day to close $387.71 — a blow-off signature after the sector's 80-100%+ YTD run. Correlated with VLO (already shortlisted) — flagged, not doubled up.
XYL — FADED vs IBKR: search reported "+1.32% to $114.92, beating the S&P," but live IBKR data shows $105.69, down 2.04%, sitting at a 13-week low. The reported pop never happened or fully reversed.
SOUN — FADED: LivePerson acquisition-completion news cited as bullish, but IBKR shows the stock flat on the day at $6.74, ~70% below its 52-week high.
GH — FADED: FDA companion-diagnostic approval cited, but its 52-week high was set over a month ago; price has drifted down ~9% since, with an intraday low of $154 on Sep4 and no confirming pop.
ONC (BeOne Medicines) — stale/no reaction: FDA approval cited, but the stock has been range-bound $357-370 for two weeks — the news isn't moving price.
CCEC — stale: only forward-dated item found was a Sep22 shareholder meeting; no live signal inside the 5-day window.
GOOS — contradicted: search cited an earnings-beat volume spike, but the actual Jul30 print was a large loss that sent the stock to a 52-week LOW, not a rally.
CAVA — wrong direction: TD Cowen actually cut its price target to $85 from $100 in August on Cyclospora food-safety concerns — bearish, not the bullish raise the initial summary implied.
SOPH — too vague: no concrete fresh volume/price catalyst confirmed.
JAKK — unverified: price-target raise attributed to an obscure/unconfirmed research source.
VSH — stale: analyst-initiation timing unclear, no confirmed live momentum this week.
TRU — halal ⚠️ + stale: core business facilitates conventional lending decisions for banks (credit bureau); also no fresh catalyst confirmed.
SMID — illiquid: avg $414K/day (too thin for a fast exit) and still near 52-week lows despite insider buying — not a confirmed reversal yet.
HOOD — halal ⚠️ excluded: this week's rally is specifically about Robinhood's push into prediction markets — event/wagering contracts are a gambling-adjacent product line, tripping the hard exclusion even though plain brokerage commissions would otherwise pass.

Cap-size & sector balance

All 4 survivors are large-cap. 11 small/mid-cap candidates were run through the full gate sequence (GSIT, CCEC, GOOS, SOPH, CAVA, JAKK, VSH, TRU, SOUN, SMID, plus GH/ONC at the smaller end) and none survived — this is a genuinely large-cap-only week, not a scan bias. Sector-wise, 3 of 4 (PFE, JNJ, SOLV) are healthcare/pharma-adjacent and 1 (VLO) is energy — see the decisions-needed note at the top before stacking multiple healthcare names.

Research output, not financial advice. Past performance does not guarantee future results. Verify halal compliance quarterly on Zoya or Musaffa. This shortlist alone is not enough to enter a trade — run analyze [TICKER] for the full deep dive first. Generated 2026-09-06 ~07:05 Kuwait time.
